manifest_summary.approach: Public-close mean-reversion ensemble: OLS AR(1) on all 60 and trailing 30 closes, slopes clipped to [0,0.995]; average forecasts at next-close fill and seven-bar mark. Buy only when forecast mark/fill return exceeds 0.15005% entry friction; otherwise hold cash. Quantity uses 90% of cash at last close including entry friction, leaving a next-close price buffer; no guarantee against arbitrary gaps. Volume unused.
manifest_summary.changes: Source version v1, exact hash sha256:2f7d8f06f8f7da2d679dae9b940dd08046c030b9daa54c6ae9cfb4b5c2ebc92a; parent none (initial submission); effective round 0. Hypothesis: deviations below estimated equilibrium may revert over the six held intervals. Actual changes: initial implementation of the 60/30-close AR ensemble, friction gate, and 90% sizing; no prior strategy modified. Fitted only to supplied public history; no out-of-sample testing or improvement claim. Only routine settlement is authoritative.

manifest_summary.approach: Long-only 30-close mean reversion: buy when last close is at least 0.5 sample standard deviations below its 30-close mean and the 29-interval return is no worse than -5%; otherwise hold cash. Buy quantity uses 90% of cash at decision-close cost including 5 bps slippage and 10 bps fee; remaining cash buffers unknown next-close execution. No guaranteed fill-price bound is assumed.
manifest_summary.changes: Version strategy-v1; source sha256=94527088b1214233f456653dfaa8e5297902698a32c82068c21b7628796041d9; parent=none; effective_round=0. Initial implementation: window=30, entry_z=-0.5, minimum_window_return=-0.05, decision_cost_allocation=0.90. Hypothesis: moderate short-horizon weakness within a non-collapsing range may mean-revert over the seven-bar scoring horizon. No prior version, backtest, parameter search, or tested improvement is claimed. Uses only supplied public closes; volume unused.
